Thankfully the opposite is also true, where an unlikely premise, when infused with heart, enthusiasm, talent and energy, can result in a surprising and uplifting success.

The West End just got a bit more sparkly as a big, fancy musical has opened at the Garrick theatre – quite literally as the big, pink glittery writing outside the theatre will attest (never a bad thing in my eyes). That musical is Why Am I So Single?, the long-awaited follow-up from Six writers Toby Marlow and Lucy Moss.
This is fun, there's no denying that, but it does feel long at just over 2 1/2 hours.

cn.t: Critics are divided on this Gen Z-focused musical from the SIX creators, with some finding it uplifting and hilarious while others criticize its flabby structure and lack of polish compared to their previous hit.
